nodes.label: CodeRabbit Four Pillars
nodes.rationale: Deterministic first pass, structural context, verification filter, and memory explain why CodeRabbit catches more than a naive LLM reviewer

nodes.label: Fingerprint + Anchor
nodes.rationale: engine/rule/path-or-glob fingerprint; anchor hash of matched line makes memory die with the code it priced

nodes.label: MCP Tool Surface
nodes.rationale: Code-graph queries, LSP diagnostics, and shell probes deliberately not wrapped: the driving agent is the sandbox

nodes.label: Memory Promotion and Hygiene
nodes.rationale: Recurring instance pricing becomes one profile/glob line; lastApplied enables GC of stale memories

nodes.label: Repo Memory Store (.leveret/memory.jsonl)
nodes.rationale: Lives in the reviewed repo, versioned and reviewable

nodes.label: Delta Scanning vs Base
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing findings dropped with multiset identity so copies of known-bad lines still surface; counted, never silent

nodes.label: Deterministic First Pass (engine registry)
nodes.rationale: Static analyzers/linters/secret and dependency scanners produce grounded leads before any LLM sees the diff

nodes.label: Repo Rulings (case law)
nodes.rationale: Rulings both suppress priced concerns and raise violations of taught conventions

nodes.label: Convention Memory Entries
nodes.rationale: Fingerprint-free teaching text that can both suppress and raise findings, closing the gap with CodeRabbit learnings

nodes.label: Importance Tiers (critical/major/minor/nit)
nodes.rationale: Review judgment by verifier, deliberately distinct from engines' mechanical severity

nodes.label: Out-of-Diff Findings
nodes.rationale: Correlated defects in untouched code are first-class, carry a stated correlation, never dropped for being outside the diff

nodes.label: Review Agent
nodes.rationale: Must trace changed symbols to call sites outside the diff; cross-file breakage is what diff-only reviewers miss

nodes.label: Verification Agent
nodes.rationale: Adversarial refute-or-evidence; generation generous, publication strict

nodes.label: Walkthrough Summary Comment
nodes.rationale: Report shows what was checked, not only what was found, so a clean review is distinguishable from a shallow one

nodes.label: Deferred Leads Triage
nodes.rationale: Deterministic leads withheld until after discovery walk; discovery concerns carry empty lead_ids

nodes.label: Dropped Claims Never Persisted
nodes.rationale: Failure to verify is not refutation; storing it as false-positive would permanently suppress a possibly-real finding class

nodes.label: Structured Verify Object + Deterministic Rendering
nodes.rationale: Model emits one report/verdicts/coverage object; deterministic code renders every presentation surface

nodes.label: Fixability classification (verified/candidate/recommendation/no known fix)
nodes.rationale: Fixability is independent of severity and affects actionability without suppressing real issues.

nodes.label: Governed detector-exception experiment
nodes.rationale: Exceptions that alter detection (e.g. sanitizers) can create false negatives, so require authority, expiry, corpus impact, and rollback; priced-noise memory stays post-detection.

nodes.label: Governed risk acceptance (reasoned, scoped, expiring ignores)
nodes.norm_label: governed risk acceptance (reasoned, scoped, expiring ignores)

nodes.label: Typed reachability evidence (reachable/no_path/unknown/not_applicable)
nodes.rationale: Both vendors warn static no-path is not proof of safety; reachability should change ranking, never silently produce clean.

nodes.label: Conjunctive card selection with hard guidance budget
nodes.norm_label: conjunctive card selection with hard guidance budget
nodes.rationale: At most six cards, 1 KiB each, 8 KiB total, so irrelevant language guidance does not occupy the prompt.

nodes.label: leveret MCP server
nodes.rationale: Interactive path deliberately not standardized: the client supplies model and sandbox and the human is present to judge.

nodes.label: LLM-semantic findings (~75% of CodeRabbit value)
nodes.rationale: ~18 of 24 CR findings need semantic review; P5 review + verification agents carry most of the value, so they were prioritized.

nodes.label: Trusted-base profile and memory
nodes.rationale: .leveret.yml and memory are read from the base commit and the Pi reviewer cannot write rulings, so a reviewed checkout cannot teach future reviews through prompt injection.

nodes.label: Deployment Modes (GitHub Actions + Webhook App)
nodes.rationale: Actions is zero-infra path; webhook App for always-on reviews with relay/tunnel docs for NAT'd hosts

nodes.label: learn MCP tool
nodes.rationale: Ingests human rulings from live PR threads and historical CodeRabbit comment mining; prioritized over further benchmarking

nodes.label: User-Owned App Branding
nodes.rationale: One webhook URL per App forces an App per user; brand rides on name prefix, hand-uploaded avatar, and comment content

nodes.label: Audit Sessions Are Evidence, Not Conversation State
nodes.norm_label: audit sessions are evidence, not conversation state
nodes.rationale: Audit artifacts are untrusted evidence and never automatic learning input; sessions never discovered from the reviewed checkout

nodes.label: GitHub App + BYOAI Split
nodes.rationale: App layer holds only GitHub key; runner layer runs on user hardware with user's model so code and credentials stay in the perimeter

nodes.label: Human Feedback as Memory Source
nodes.rationale: CodeRabbit parity: maintainer replies are the main learnings source; human-taught entries outrank agent-graded ones and persist

nodes.label: BYOM Providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, local)
nodes.rationale: Both providers via API key and subscription OAuth; configurable base URL with optional key enables local OpenAI-compatible backends and offline review

nodes.label: Code Graph (CodeGraph + code-only Graphify)
nodes.rationale: Traces changed symbols to call sites outside the diff; built and validated at exact checkout before model work

nodes.label: leveret-runner-pi (Pi harness)
nodes.rationale: The harness is part of the reviewer; Pi pinned because provider catalog and SDK shape affect reviews

nodes.label: leveret_submit_phase terminal tool
nodes.rationale: Provider validates typed phase arguments; runner never parses assistant text as JSON

nodes.label: Serena Staged Bundle (LEVERET_SERENA_BUNDLE)
nodes.rationale: Runtime LSP downloads refused; warm one symbol query per packaged language before model phases

nodes.label: Validation Gate (Parity Benchmark)
nodes.rationale: Leveret changes nothing in reviewed repos until the benchmark passes; CodeRabbit retirement blocked unless every gate passes

nodes.label: vscode-langservers-extracted
nodes.rationale: HTML language server pre-staged into the Serena bundle, not installed as a Leveret runtime dependency

nodes.label: Reviewer Toolbelt
nodes.rationale: Engines and indexes are reviewer capabilities installed beside Leveret, not in the reviewed repo

nodes.label: Reviewed Checkout Isolation
nodes.rationale: Checkout is never Pi's cwd so project-local settings/hooks/prompts cannot alter the session; PR-head policy cannot disable review or suppress its own findings

nodes.label: Autonomous Runs Cannot Write Memory
nodes.rationale: Prevents review-target prompt injection from teaching future reviews; only versioned repo memory and authenticated human learn feed write

nodes.label: leveret.evidence-pack/v1
nodes.rationale: Single bounded, hash-validated handoff; static analyzer cleanliness is explicitly not semantic coverage.

nodes.label: leveret.guidance-result/v1
nodes.rationale: Only host-packaged, source-pinned caveat cards; PR or repo text cannot create or widen trusted cards or rules.

nodes.label: leveret-runner-pi
nodes.rationale: Runs Pi from in-memory sessions in a host-owned directory outside the checkout so project-local settings, extensions, prompts and executables cannot extend the session.

nodes.label: Hash-pinned model routing
nodes.rationale: Routing config must live outside the checkout and match its declared SHA-256 so reviewed content cannot choose models.

nodes.label: leveret.work-item/v1
nodes.rationale: PR title/body/author fields are untrusted evidence with provenance; they cannot change tools, policy, schema or authorization.

nodes.label: Private audit traces
nodes.rationale: Default fail mode aborts rather than silently losing evidence; .partial dirs preserve crashed attempts; secrets redacted before persistence.

nodes.label: LEVERET_REQUIRE_INDEXES gate
nodes.rationale: Autonomous reviews fail before model work unless CodeGraph, Graphify and Serena all prove ready; =0 only for explicitly degraded runs.

nodes.label: Review cache (review-v1)
nodes.rationale: Versioned keys over base/head, profile, tool, prompt, policy and knowledge identities; corrupt entries are recomputed rather than treated as clean; unchanged findings are not republished.

nodes.label: Serena LSP bundle
nodes.rationale: Prefetched at install time; reviews refuse runtime LSP downloads and host-toolchain-only languages are not advertised.

nodes.label: typos/typo suppressions (test/**, bench/results/**)
nodes.rationale: Test fixtures plant misspellings; benchmark reports quote scanned material verbatim

nodes.label: Grade: priced-noise
nodes.rationale: True but deliberately not worth fixing; recorded with rationale so pricing is auditable and never re-litigated

nodes.label: Profile Layer (.leveret.yml)
nodes.rationale: Cheapest deterministic layer; per-engine path scopes, severity floors, suppressions each with a reason; suppressions reported, never silent

nodes.label: Three-Grade Filter
nodes.rationale: v0.1 probe showed true-but-inert findings (SC2162) must not post, so a binary real/false-positive filter is insufficient

nodes.label: Rejected #2521 tar suggestion (regression case)
nodes.rationale: A plausible bot suggestion would have made an assertion tautological; counterevidence against treating every plausible comment as correct.
